title: Topological degree for singular $N$-mean field equations
summary: We determine the Leray--Schauder degree of the singular Dirichlet $N$-mean field equation on a smooth bounded domain in $\mathbb{R}^N$, $N\geq2$, for every positive nonresonant parameter and singular exponents $-1<α_i\leq0$. The formula depends only on the Euler characteristic of the domain and the weights $(1+α_i)^{N-1}$. We also identify the homotopy type of every sufficiently negative variational sublevel with the corresponding weighted barycenter space.
